Lamine Yamal becomes the youngest player in the history of Europe’s top five leagues to reach 5️⃣0️⃣ goals, surpassing Haaland and Mbappé.

Lamine Yamal es converteix en el jugador més jove de la història de les cinc grans lligues a arribar als 50 gols.

No matter how old you are, there’s always something you haven’t tried yet.

Swipe to see @cowboykentrollins try his very first @hersheys Cookies ’n’ Creme s’more, introduced by his granddaughter. 

What’s something you didn’t try until way later in life? ❤️

Mirzapur fever is at an all-time high! 🔥 

After keeping fans hooked through seasons of power, revenge, politics, rivalries and unforgettable characters, the madness is finally making its way to the big screen. With the much-loved cast including Pankaj Tripathi, Ali Fazal, Divyenndu, Shweta Tripathi Sharma, Rasika Dugal and Vikrant Massey bringing the world of Mirzapur to life, expectations are already sky-high.

 The world of Mirzapur has always been about larger-than-life drama and unpredictable twists, and now fans get to experience that chaos in theatres. The wait is almost over as Mirzapur arrives on the big screen on the 4th. Time to bring back the dialogues, the theories and the madness, but this time with a theatre full of fans! 🍿🔥
